tagline: Surface Todoist tasks in Teams and capture action items from chats
metaTitle: Todoist + Microsoft Teams Integration: Task Alerts in Teams
metaDescription: Start each day knowing what is due. GAIA sends a Todoist briefing and due-date alerts to Microsoft Teams and saves Teams messages as tasks. See the setup steps.
intro:
Microsoft Teams is the communication backbone of millions of organizations, hosting everything from quick chat messages to full project discussions. But the action items that emerge from those conversations routinely disappear into the chat history, never making it to a task manager. Todoist users who rely on it for personal planning find themselves manually transcribing chat commitments into tasks — a slow, error-prone process that means many follow-ups simply never get captured.

GAIA bridges the two so your task manager and your team chat reinforce each other. Task reminders and deadline alerts surface as Teams notifications in the channels where your team is active. Conversely, when an action item surfaces in a message or meeting chat, GAIA can capture it as a Todoist task with one command, preserving the original message as context.

This integration is particularly powerful in organizations that run on Microsoft 365, where chat is the daily hub but individual contributors want the simplicity of a dedicated task manager for personal planning. It removes the friction of switching between platforms while ensuring commitments made in chat always make it to the task list.

useCases.title: Task due-date alerts in Teams channels
useCases.description: GAIA sends a message to the relevant channel when a task deadline approaches, tagging the responsible person so the team is never surprised by a missed deadline.

useCases.title: Capture Teams messages as Todoist tasks
useCases.description: Reply to any message with a GAIA command or use a message action to convert it into a task without leaving the chat, with the message content, sender, and channel context preserved.

useCases.title: Morning task briefing
useCases.description: GAIA posts your due-today list as a personal message each morning so your day's priorities are visible right when you open your collaboration hub.

useCases.title: Meeting action item capture
useCases.description: After a meeting, GAIA processes the meeting transcript or chat log to identify action items and creates a task for each commitment made during the call.

useCases.title: Project progress updates
useCases.description: When a project reaches a completion milestone, GAIA posts a progress update to the designated channel so stakeholders are informed without a manual status message.

howItWorks.step: Connect Todoist and Microsoft Teams to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your account and add the GAIA app to your Teams workspace. Your Microsoft 365 admin may need to approve the app installation.
Map projects to channels, set reminder lead times, and enable the message capture command so team members can start converting chat messages to tasks.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps tasks and chat aligned
howItWorks.description: GAIA watches the task list for upcoming deadlines and the chat for capture triggers, posting alerts and creating tasks automatically so both stay current.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require a Microsoft 365 admin to install?
faqs.answer: Individual users can install GAIA as a personal app without admin approval. For organization-wide deployment, an admin may need to approve the app in the admin center.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post to both channels and personal chats?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can send task alerts to shared channels for team-visible deadlines and to personal chats for private reminders.

faqs.question: Will GAIA capture tasks from Teams meeting chats?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA monitors meeting chat threads and can extract action items from in-meeting messages, creating tasks after the meeting ends.

faqs.question: Does this work on mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes. Since both apps have mobile versions and GAIA operates server-side, the integration works regardless of which device you use to access the chat.
